mapper.update: update idevelop_safeaccess_user_access set subnet_id = #{subnetId}, ip_address = #{IP}, is802 = #{networkAccessMethod}, device_id = #{deviceId}, device_uuid = #{uuid}, device_ci_id = #{ciId}, device_type = #{deviceTypeCode}, device_type_name = #{deviceType}, device_code = #{deviceCode} where id = #{userAccessId} and is_deleted = 0

update idevelop_safeaccess_user_access set mi_charge_user = #{user}, mi_user = #{receivingPerson}, address = #{installationSite}, phone = #{userTel}, dept_code = #{receiveDeptCode} where device_code = #{deviceCode} and is_deleted = 0
